title: Longitudinal Studies
summary: The free-floating subdivision --Longitudinal studies may be used as a form ($v) or topical ($x) subdivision under topical headings and headings for classes of persons and ethnic groups, for works reporting results of longitudinal studies, discussing their methods, or covering case studies longitudinally.
validation_rules: `--Longitudinal studies` is free-floating under topical headings and headings for classes of persons and ethnic groups. (H 1848 sec. 1)

`--Longitudinal studies` may be used either as a form subdivision (`$v`, works reporting results of longitudinal studies) or as a topical subdivision (`$x`, works discussing methods and techniques of conducting them). (H 1848 sec. 1)

`--Longitudinal studies` may follow geographic and topical subdivisions, e.g. `Nurses--United States--Longitudinal studies`; `Older people--Wisconsin--Nutrition--Longitudinal studies`. (H 1848 sec. 1, 2)
Use `--Longitudinal studies` also for works covering one or more case studies longitudinally. (H 1848 sec. 2)

sections.heading: 1. General usage of --Longitudinal studies.
sections.text:
Use the free-floating subdivision --Longitudinal studies as either a form or a topical subdivision under topical headings and headings for classes of persons and ethnic groups for works that report the results of longitudinal studies or discuss the methods and techniques of conducting them. Examples:

```
Title: Longitudinal research on drug use : empirical findings and Methodological issues.
650 #0 $a Drug abuse $x Longitudinal studies.

Title: RN's one and five years after graduation.
650 #0 $a Nurses $z United States $v Longitudinal studies.

Title: Patterns of aggregate and individual changes in contraceptive practice : United States, 1965-1975.
650 #0 $a Birth control $z United States $v Longitudinal studies.
650 #0 $a Contraception $z United States $v Longitudinal studies.
```

sections.heading: 2. Longitudinal case studies.
sections.text:
Use --Longitudinal studies for works that cover one or more case studies longitudinally. Examples:

```
Title: Longitudinal evaluation of a Wisconsin nutrition program for the elderly.
650 #0 $a Food relief $z Wisconsin $v Longitudinal studies.
650 #0 $a Older people $z Wisconsin $x Nutrition $v Longitudinal studies.

Title: The persistence of preschool effects : a long-term follow-up of fourteen infant and preschool experiments.
650 #0 $a Education, Preschool $z United States $x Longitudinal studies.
```
